After session 2 the supporting evidence is: floor 18 flat across two sessions and 14 measured spellings; H1 confirmed empirically 14/14; and a complete family census showing this is the last unauthorized member of a settled cluster whose only other delay-slot-filled member was authorized on this exact ground (func_80052B44, src/text1b.c:10995, inline_asm_canonical.txt:340, 2026-07-27).

frontier.hypothesis: The register-allocation axis (8 of the 18 points) has no C-level steering lever, so even a hypothetical fix cannot reach 0.
frontier.mechanism: Session 1's H2 established this by mechanism: in a call-free leaf GCC draws temps from the caller-save pool in fixed order and defers the self-clobbering matrix[0] load; there is no arithmetic, control flow, or call in the body to bias allocno priority or liveness. Session 2's 8 floor-tying spellings are consistent with that (the allocation never changed).

frontier.hypothesis: The remaining sanctioned modalities (forensics / rederive / synthesis) have no new axis to open on this function.
frontier.mechanism: The body is 8 array reads feeding 8 cop2 writes: no arithmetic to restructure, no control flow to reshape, no call to reorder, no type to correct, no data layout to re-attribute. Sessions 1 and 2 have measured or mechanically settled every component of the 18-point residual.
frontier.next_probe: Rather than opening a new axis, the cheapest remaining measurement is a diff of func_80052B00's target against the authorized func_80052B44 block instruction-for-instruction to confirm the two are the same construct at different widths (8-word vs 5-word matrix) — a 1-turn probe that strengthens the precedent citation for frontier item 1 without re-running any dead lever.
